deḍḍubha.p: [Deḍḍu+ubha] (pu,na) Google Translate Dhan, T.651.] (Pu) (1) Water snake. (Na) (2) The smell of water snake. The smell of a water snake. (3) The head of a water snake. Dedubba: Look.
a: ဒေဍ္ဍုဘ(ပု၊န)

H: deḍḍubha：，deḍḍubhaka m．水蛇，蛇頭形的帶子（a kind of girdle in the form of a snake's head）.
B:
deḍḍubha：deḍḍubha（pu，na）
ဒေဍ္ဍုဘ（ပု၊န）
[deḍḍu+ubha．，ṭī.651.]
[ဒေဍ္ဍု+ဥဘ။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၆၅၁။]
P: Deḍḍubha，[Sk．duṇḍubha] a water-snake； salamander J.III，16； VI，194； Sdhp.292．See next．（Page 328）
R:
deḍḍubha：ဒေဍ္ဍုဘ （ပ）
ရေမြွေ။
DOP: deḍḍubha m. [ cf S. duṇḍubha], 1. a kind of lizard; a water-snake ; Abh 651 (~o rājulo); Vin IV 110, 5 (api nu kho bhikkhave Sāgato etarahi pahoti ~enāpi saddhiṃ saṅgāmetun ti, Ce, Se so; Be, Ee nāgena; cf Ja I 361, 6 : kiṃ pan’ etarahi Sāgato udakadeḍḍubhakaṃ pi dametuṃ sakkuṇeyyā ti); Thī 23 (ukkhalikā me ~aṃ vāti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se wr daḷiddabhāvā ti; Thī-a 28, 18 foll. : me mama bhattapacanabhājanaṃ … udakasappagandhaṃ vāyati); Ja VI 194, 16* (siyā visaṃ siluttassa ~assa silābhuno, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se duḍḍubhassa; 194, 18´ : udakasappassa); Saddh 292; — 2. [ see deḍḍubhaka] a kind of belt ; Vin-vn 3056 (~aṃ ca kalābukaṃ).
NCP: masculine a | de.d.dubha water snake; a kind of lizard.

deḍḍubhaka.p: [Deḍḍubha+ka] CL=9 Like the head of a water snake. having the shape of the head of a water snake.
a: ဒေဍ္ဍုဘက(တိ)

B:
deḍḍubhaka：deḍḍubhaka（ti）
ဒေဍ္ဍုဘက（တိ）
[deḍḍubha+ka]
[ဒေဍ္ဍုဘ+က]
P: Deḍḍubhaka，1．a sort of snake （see prec.） J.I，361．-- 2．a kind of girdle （in the form of a snake’s head） Vin.II，136 （expl<sup>d</sup> by udaka-sappi-sira-sadisa）．（Page 328）
K:
deḍḍubhaka：ဒေဍ္ဍုဘက（တိ）
[ဒေဍ္ဍုဘ+က]
ရေမြွေ၏ ဦးခေါင်းနှင့် တူသော၊ ရေမြွေ ဦးခေါင်းသဏ္ဌာန်ရှိသော။
R:
deḍḍubhaka：ဒေဍ္ဍုဘက （ပ）
ရေမြွေ၏ ဦးခေါင်းသဏ္ဌာန်ပြုအပ်သော ခါးပန်း။
DOP: deḍḍubhaka m. [deḍḍubha + ka 2 ], 1. a kind of lizard; a water-snake ; — ifc see udaka-; — 2. a kind of girdle or belt ; Vin II 136, 7 (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāvacāni kāyabandhanāni dhārenti kalābukaṃ ~aṃ …; Sp 1211, 21 : ~aṃ nāma udakasappasīsasadisaṃ).
NCP: masculine | de.d.dubhaka a water snake; a kind of lizard. a kind of girdle or belt.
